challenge.name: Inconsistent Data Labeling
challenge.description: #reliability_ruth# believes that labeling should be fully automated and governed to ensure consistent data quality. #data_dave# wants to keep it manual for flexibility. #data_dave# is willing to compromise on a semi-manual approach, but #reliability_ruth# insists on strict governance.

output.content: Hi all, I’ve been thinking about the data labeling process. I understand the push for automation, but I need to be clear: I will not accept any solution that takes control away from me. Data labeling is too critical to hand off to a system without human oversight. I’m open to discussing improvements, but my team needs to remain in charge of the process. Best, {data_dave}
output.reclassify_reason: The message explicitly states a condition that, if crossed, would result in refusal.
